subtopic: Sector Concentration and Overlapping Fund Holdings
source_evidence: you should check the top holdings of the funds to make sure they are different
answer: Diversification can be reduced when several funds hold many of the same investments, even if you own multiple funds. Check each fund’s top holdings to see whether they are different. Also note that a fund focused narrowly on one industry sector may not provide broad diversification by itself; you may need other funds to spread investments across sectors.
